subject: crackme1
note: Prose by Claude; every address, constant and count is a {slot} filled from the witnessed harvest, call graph or re-run hypothesis ledger. gate_re_fact fails any digit outside a slot.

claims.speaker: the graph says
claims.text: Every path from program entry to the serial check {target} crosses one function: {passage}. It carries the highest betweenness in the call graph, which is why the constellation draws it gold.

claims.speaker: disasm says
claims.text: {anti_count} functions touch anti-analysis machinery: the constructor calls ptrace(TRACEME) and the checker compares its own bytes against {brk}, the software-breakpoint marker. Both wear a hot roof in the city.

claims.speaker: the lattice says
claims.text: Formal concept analysis over functions x imported capabilities finds {concepts} concepts without running the binary, among them an anti-debug concept shared by {anti_extent}.

claims.speaker: the experiments say
claims.text: {confirmed} of {total} hypotheses were re-run here and confirmed; the reconstructed keygen was accepted by the binary for {accepted} random names and every one of {mutants} mutated serials was rejected.

claims.speaker: gdb and the native run disagree
claims.text: Under gdb the program reads salt {salt_gdb} and accepts {poisoned} for alice; run natively it rejects that serial and accepts {true} instead.
